product_one_liner.value: Pack is an AI-powered change-management platform for HR teams that maps workforce skills, assesses capability gaps and creates personalized development paths aligned with business strategy.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage and pricing URL show a coming-soon/contact page rather than pricing plans, with no pricing navigation link.

named_customers.notes: Both companies have named Pack case studies.

employee_band.notes: Reported headcount is 248, corroborated by 251 LinkedIn-associated profiles; however, LinkedIn's company-size label says 11–50, so the sources conflict.

hq_location.notes: The company profile explicitly identifies Barcelona, Spain as its headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed indexes contain HR, leadership and people-development content, not qualifying engineering posts.

public_docs.notes: The public homepage has no documentation, help-center or developer-portal link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-positions board lists AE, BDR and Full Stack Developer roles, but no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No named model or provider was found in the reviewed product information, blog, privacy policy or terms; no public subprocessor list or product documentation was located.

compliance_certs.notes: Pack explicitly claims GDPR compliance; this is not an independently verified certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced December 2, 2025; co-lead investor Acadian Ventures reports the round as $6.7 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The December 2025 Series A falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Open roles include Mid AE FRA Enterprise and several BDR positions; the AE posting has an application link and a December 31, 2026 deadline.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying release was found in the readable blog and company-post history for May 9–November 9, 2026; the homepage advertises a forthcoming December 1 launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The published small team list identifies CEO Pietro Maria Picogna and CPO Giacomo Gentili as co-founders; no qualifying appointment or departure was found for the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The account-executive posting explicitly names CRM use: HubSpot.
